exercises.cardText:
Smith Machine Hanging Knee Tuck
Beginner
1
Put a hip thrust pad on the smith machine bar at neck height. Put both arms over the bar and pull your feet off the ground.
2
Pull your knees to your chest and flex your abs.
exercises.name: Smith Machine Hanging Knee Tuck

exercises.cardText:
Smith Machine Reverse Crunch Hip Raise
Intermediate
1
Lay flat on the ground. With your feet on the bar.
2
Lift your hips off the ground.
exercises.name: Smith Machine Reverse Crunch Hip Raise

exercises.cardText:
Smith Machine Situp
Beginner
1
Set up the Smith machine bar at an appropriate height.
2
Lie on your back beneath the bar, gripping it with your hands.
3
Engage your core, lift your upper body toward the bar, and exhale.
4
Lower your upper body back down in a controlled manner, inhaling.
exercises.name: Smith Machine Situp

exercises.cardText:
Smith Machine Drag Curl
Beginner
1
Grab the bar with an underhand grip.
2
Pull your elbows straight back and let the bar drag against your upper body (or very close to it).
exercises.name: Smith Machine Drag Curl

exercises.cardText:
Smith Machine Underhand Row
Novice
1
Begin by standing in front of a bar with your feet about hip-width apart.
2
Bend at the hips and knees to grab the bar with a supinated (underhand) grip, positioning the bar about an inch away from your shins.
3
Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, use your back muscles to lift the bar straight up towards your chest.
4
As the bar reaches your chest, pause briefly, and then lower the bar back to the starting position.
exercises.name: Smith Machine Underhand Row

exercises.cardText:
Smith Machine Overhand Row
Beginner
1
Start hinged forward with a flat back. Make sure your elbows are fully extended.
2
Pull the bar to your sternum.
exercises.name: Smith Machine Overhand Row

exercises.cardText:
Smith Machine Drag Curl
Beginner
1
Grab the bar with an underhand grip.
2
Pull your elbows straight back and let the bar drag against your upper body (or very close to it).
exercises.name: Smith Machine Drag Curl

Novice
1
Begin by standing in front of a bar with your feet about hip-width apart.
2
Bend at the hips and knees to grab the bar with a supinated (underhand) grip, positioning the bar about an inch away from your shins.
3
Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, use your back muscles to lift the bar straight up towards your chest.
4

exercises.name: Smith Machine Underhand Row

exercises.cardText:
Smith Machine Overhand Row
Beginner
1
Start hinged forward with a flat back. Make sure your elbows are fully extended.
2
Pull the bar to your sternum.
exercises.name: Smith Machine Overhand Row

exercises.cardText:
Smith Machine Seated Calf Raise
Novice
1
Start by sitting on a bench or box with the bar resting on your knees. Your feet should be flat on the ground, about hip-width apart.
2
Place your hands on the barbell for support, and lift your heels off the ground.
3
Hold this position for a moment, then slowly lower your heels back to the ground.
exercises.name: Smith Machine Seated Calf Raise

exercises.cardText:
Smith Machine Calf Raise
Novice
1
Place the bar on your back
2
Start with feet flat on the ground
3
Extend your heels upwards while keeping your knees stationary, and pause at the contracted position.
4
Slowly return to the starting position. Repeat.
exercises.name: Smith Machine Calf Raise

exercises.cardText:
Smith Machine Seated Calf Raise
Novice
1
Start by sitting on a bench or box with the bar resting on your knees. Your feet should be flat on the ground, about hip-width apart.
2

3

exercises.name: Smith Machine Seated Calf Raise

Smith Machine Calf Raise
Novice
1
Place the bar on your back
2
Start with feet flat on the ground
3
Extend your heels upwards while keeping your knees stationary, and pause at the contracted position.
4
Slowly return to the starting position. Repeat.
exercises.name: Smith Machine Calf Raise

exercises.cardText:
Smith Machine Guillotine Bench Press
Intermediate
1
Lie on the flat bench, grasp the bar at shoulder level with your palms facing forward.
2
Slowly lower the bar to your chest, keeping your elbows flared out.
3
Once you feel a stretch in your chest press the weight back up.
exercises.name: Smith Machine Guillotine Bench Press

exercises.cardText:
Smith Machine Bench Press
Novice
1
Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground. With straight arms unrack the bar.
2
Lower the bar to your mid chest
3
Raise the bar until you've locked your elbows.
exercises.name: Smith Machine Bench Press

exercises.cardText:
Smith Machine Incline Bench Press
Beginner
1
Position the bench between 30 and 45 degrees.
2
Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground. With straight arms unrack the bar.
3
Lower the bar to your mid chest
4
Raise the bar (slowly and controlled) until you've locked your elbows.
exercises.name: Smith Machine Incline Bench Press

exercises.cardText:
Smith Machine Pushup
Beginner
1
Place hands on the bar, in push-up position.
2
Lower yourself to the bar, maintaining proper form.
exercises.name: Smith Machine Pushup

exercises.cardText:
Smith Machine Guillotine Bench Press
Intermediate
1
Lie on the flat bench, grasp the bar at shoulder level with your palms facing forward.
2
Slowly lower the bar to your chest, keeping your elbows flared out.
3
Once you feel a stretch in your chest press the weight back up.
exercises.name: Smith Machine Guillotine Bench Press

Smith Machine Pushup

1
Place hands on the bar, in push-up position.
2
Lower yourself to the bar, maintaining proper form.
exercises.name: Smith Machine Pushup

exercises.cardText:
Smith Machine Inverted Row
Beginner
1
Lay underneath a fixed horizontal bar and grab the bar with a wide overhand grip.
2
Pull your body straight up to the bar.
3
Return to the starting position, your arms fully extended. Repeat.
exercises.name: Smith Machine Inverted Row

exercises.cardText:
Smith Machine Inverted Row
Beginner
1
Lay underneath a fixed horizontal bar and grab the bar with a wide overhand grip.
2
Pull your body straight up to the bar.
3
Return to the starting position, your arms fully extended. Repeat.
exercises.name: Smith Machine Inverted Row

exercises.cardText:
Smith Machine Upright Row
Intermediate
1
Take a double overhand roughly shoulder width grip.
2
Pull your elbows straight up the ceiling. Aim to get the bar to chin level or slightly higher.
3
lower the bar and repeat.
exercises.name: Smith Machine Upright Row

Novice

exercises.cardText:
Smith Machine Seated Overhead Press
Beginner
1
Sit on a bench with back support. Raise the bar to shoulder height with your palms forward.
2
Raise the bar upwards and pause at the contracted position.
3
Lower the weight back to starting position.
exercises.name: Smith Machine Seated Overhead Press

exercises.cardText:
Smith Machine Upright Row
Intermediate
1
Take a double overhand roughly shoulder width grip.
2

3
lower the bar and repeat.

1

2
Raise the bar upwards and pause at the contracted position.
3
Lower the weight back to starting position.
exercises.name: Smith Machine Seated Overhead Press

exercises.cardText:
Smith Machine Staggered Deadlift
Intermediate
1
Place one foot behind. You should only be on your toes on that back foot. Your front foot should be planted flat the entire time.
2
Bend your back knee and push your hips back. Look for a stretch in your front hamstring.
3
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward again until you're back in a standing position.
exercises.name: Smith Machine Staggered Deadlift

exercises.cardText:
Smith Machine Glute Kickback
Intermediate
1
Start on your hands and knees with one foot placed on the bottom of the bar.
2
Keeping your core braced, your back flat, and your moving leg bent at a 90 degree angle, drive the heel of your working leg up the ceiling while squeezing your glute.
3
Follow the movement path as you bring your knee back down to the ground beneath your hip, keeping your knee bent to maintain control of the bar.
4
Repeat for the desired number of reps before switching sides.
exercises.name: Smith Machine Glute Kickback

exercises.cardText:
Smith Machine Leg Press
Intermediate
1
Place your legs on the bar with your feet at shoulder width.
2
Release the weight and extend your legs fully, without locking your knees.
3
Lower the weight until your legs are at a 90° angle (but DO NOT allow your butt and lower back to rise off of the floor. This will put your lower back in a rounded position, which is very dangerous.)
4
Raise the weight back to starting position.
exercises.name: Smith Machine Leg Press

exercises.cardText:
Smith Machine Single Leg Hip Thrust
Intermediate
1
Start by lying on a bench with your foot on the ground and a barbell on your hips.
2
Lift one leg off the ground and engage your glutes to raise your hips up towards the ceiling.
3
From this starting position, slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
exercises.name: Smith Machine Single Leg Hip Thrust

exercises.cardText:
Smith Machine Hip Thrust
Novice
1
Sit on the ground with a bench behind you. Have the bar over your legs just above your hips.
2
Lean back against the bench so that your shoulders are resting upon it, stretch your arms out to either side using the bench as support.
3
Raise the weight by driving through your feet and extending your hips upwards. Support the weight with your shoulders and feet.
4
Slowly extend as far as you can, and then slowly return to the starting position.
exercises.name: Smith Machine Hip Thrust

exercises.cardText:
Smith Machine Sumo Romanian Deadlift
Intermediate
1
Stance width can vary with a sumo DL. Some prefer toes near the plates. Others prefer a more narrow stance to get more drive off the floor.
2
Make sure your arms are inside your legs. The bar should be just over your mid-foot. Flatten your back and unrack the bar
3
Leave your knees mostly extended and flex and extend your hips.
exercises.name: Smith Machine Sumo Romanian Deadlift

exercises.cardText:
Smith Machine Romanian Deadlift
Beginner
1
Take a shoulder width, double overhand or mixed grip.
2
Push your hips back while leaving your knees mostly extended. Look for a stretch in your hamstrings.
3
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward until you're back in a standing position.
exercises.name: Smith Machine Romanian Deadlift

exercises.cardText:
Smith Machine Split Squat
Intermediate
1
Take a large step forward with one leg until your shoulders are under the smith machine
2
lower your body until your back knee nearly touches the ground. Your front knee should be bent at a 90-degree angle, and your back leg should be straight.
3
Push through the heel of your front foot to raise your body back to the starting position.
exercises.name: Smith Machine Split Squat

exercises.cardText:
Smith Machine Reverse Lunge
Intermediate
1
Start by standing with your feet about hip-width apart, with the bar on your shoulders. Your feet should be slightly pointed outward, and your shoulders should be down and relaxed.
2
Step backward with one foot, lowering your body until your front thigh is parallel to the ground and your back knee is hovering just above the ground.
3
Push off your back foot, returning to the starting position.
exercises.name: Smith Machine Reverse Lunge

exercises.cardText:
Smith Machine Narrow Stance Squat
Beginner
1
Place the bar on top of your traps. Take a narrow stance.
2
Push your hips back and break at the knees. Push your elbows forward to keep yourself from getting pitched too far forward.
3
Aim to get your hamstrings to parallel with the floor.
4
Push your heels into the floor and squat back to a standing position.
exercises.name: Smith Machine Narrow Stance Squat

exercises.cardText:
Smith Machine Romanian Deadlift
Beginner
1
Take a shoulder width, double overhand or mixed grip.
2
Push your hips back while leaving your knees mostly extended. Look for a stretch in your hamstrings.
3
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward until you're back in a standing position.
exercises.name: Smith Machine Romanian Deadlift

exercises.cardText:
Smith Machine Oblique Crunch
Advanced
1
Lay on your side with your knees bent.
2
Hold the bar extended over you.
3
Lift yourself up by flexing your obliques.
exercises.name: Smith Machine Oblique Crunch

exercises.cardText:
Smith Machine Side Plank Up Down
Beginner
1
Start by lying on your side with your feet stacked on top of each other and the bar on your hip.
2
Place your bottom elbow on the ground beneath your shoulder and engage your core to raise your hips off the ground.
3
Your hips will do all the moving. Think, "hips up, hips down."
exercises.name: Smith Machine Side Plank Up Down

exercises.cardText:
Smith Machine Side Bend
Novice
1
Stand beside the bar.
2
Keep your hips and shoulders facing forward, bend to one side slowly
3
Return to the upright position.
4
Switch hands and repeat.
exercises.name: Smith Machine Side Bend

exercises.cardText:
Smith Machine Oblique Crunch
Advanced
1
Lay on your side with your knees bent.
2
Hold the bar extended over you.
3
Lift yourself up by flexing your obliques.
exercises.name: Smith Machine Oblique Crunch

1
Stand beside the bar.
2
Keep your hips and shoulders facing forward, bend to one side slowly
3
Return to the upright position.
4

exercises.name: Smith Machine Side Bend

exercises.cardText:
Smith Machine Squat
Beginner
1
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart. Maintain the natural arch in your back and put the bar on your back. Squeezing your shoulder blades and raise your chest.
2
Grip the bar across your shoulders and support it on your upper back. Unwrack the smith machine by straightening your legs.
3
Bend your knees as you lower the weight without altering the form of your back until your hips are below your knees.
4
Raise the bar back to starting position, lift with your legs and exhale at the top.
exercises.name: Smith Machine Squat

exercises.cardText:
Smith Machine Sissy Squat
Advanced
1
Stand facing away from the machine, positioning your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width apart to provide a stable base, and then reach behind you to firmly grip the bar with both hands, maintaining an overhand grip.
2
Initiate the movement by leaning backward, allowing your upper body to incline while simultaneously bending your knees. As you descend, maintain control
3
drive through your quadriceps while pushing your hips forward, gradually straightening your knees. Maintain a slow, controlled pace
exercises.name: Smith Machine Sissy Squat

exercises.cardText:
Smith Machine Leg Press
Intermediate
1
Place your legs on the bar with your feet at shoulder width.
2
Release the weight and extend your legs fully, without locking your knees.
3
Lower the weight until your legs are at a 90° angle (but DO NOT allow your butt and lower back to rise off of the floor. This will put your lower back in a rounded position, which is very dangerous.)
4
Raise the weight back to starting position.
exercises.name: Smith Machine Leg Press

exercises.cardText:
Smith Machine Split Squat
Intermediate
1
Take a large step forward with one leg until your shoulders are under the smith machine
2
lower your body until your back knee nearly touches the ground. Your front knee should be bent at a 90-degree angle, and your back leg should be straight.
3
Push through the heel of your front foot to raise your body back to the starting position.
exercises.name: Smith Machine Split Squat

exercises.cardText:
Smith Machine Reverse Lunge
Intermediate
1
Start by standing with your feet about hip-width apart, with the bar on your shoulders. Your feet should be slightly pointed outward, and your shoulders should be down and relaxed.
2
Step backward with one foot, lowering your body until your front thigh is parallel to the ground and your back knee is hovering just above the ground.
3
Push off your back foot, returning to the starting position.
exercises.name: Smith Machine Reverse Lunge

exercises.cardText:
Smith Machine Narrow Stance Squat
Beginner
1
Place the bar on top of your traps. Take a narrow stance.
2
Push your hips back and break at the knees. Push your elbows forward to keep yourself from getting pitched too far forward.
3
Aim to get your hamstrings to parallel with the floor.
4
Push your heels into the floor and squat back to a standing position.
exercises.name: Smith Machine Narrow Stance Squat

exercises.cardText:
Smith Machine Upright Row
Intermediate
1
Take a double overhand roughly shoulder width grip.
2
Pull your elbows straight up the ceiling. Aim to get the bar to chin level or slightly higher.
3
lower the bar and repeat.

exercises.cardText:
Smith Machine Inverted Row
Beginner
1
Lay underneath a fixed horizontal bar and grab the bar with a wide overhand grip.
2
Pull your body straight up to the bar.
3
Return to the starting position, your arms fully extended. Repeat.
exercises.name: Smith Machine Inverted Row

exercises.cardText:
Smith Machine Assisted Pullup
Novice
1
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, arms and shoulders fully extended. Leave your feet on the floor.
2
Pull your body up until your chin is above the bar. Use your legs top assist you up.
3
Lower your body back to starting position.
exercises.name: Smith Machine Assisted Pullup

exercises.cardText:
Smith Machine Skullcrusher
Intermediate
1
Take a shoulder width grip. Break at the elbows. Try to keep your elbows tucked in. Don't let them flare out.
2
Stop the bar a few inches from your forehead and extend your elbows back up.
exercises.name: Smith Machine Skullcrusher

exercises.cardText:
Smith Machine Guillotine Bench Press
Intermediate
1
Lie on the flat bench, grasp the bar at shoulder level with your palms facing forward.
2
Slowly lower the bar to your chest, keeping your elbows flared out.
3
Once you feel a stretch in your chest press the weight back up.
exercises.name: Smith Machine Guillotine Bench Press

exercises.cardText:
Smith Machine Close Grip Bench Press
Beginner
1
Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground. With a narrow grip on the bar, straighten your arms
2
Lower the bar to your lower-mid chest
3
Slowly raise the bar until you've locked your elbows.
exercises.name: Smith Machine Close Grip Bench Press

2
Keep your elbows tucked in and then flex and extend at the elbows.
